data.heading: Moving or cancelling
data.intro: Plans change. This is how to move or cancel a booking, and what happens to anything you have paid.

items.question: How do I move or cancel?
items.answer: Use the link in your booking confirmation email, or call us. Please let us know at least 24 hours before, so someone else can have the time.

items.question: Deposits and late changes
items.answer: If you paid a deposit, it comes off your fee on the day. Cancel or move with at least 24 hours’ notice and it is refunded or moved to your new time. Once your 14 days to change your mind have passed (see below), a deposit may be kept if you cancel with less notice or miss the appointment.

items.question: Refunds
items.answer: Refunds go back to the card or account you paid with. Your bank may take a few days to show it.

items.question: Booked online, by phone or by email?
items.answer: You can cancel for any reason until 14 days after the day you book, and we refund what you paid. If you asked us to start within those 14 days and have already had some of the service, you pay for the part you have had. We will ask you to confirm if you would like to start that soon.
